trust.title: Signed, notarized, ready to open.

cards.title: Double click and you're in
cards.body: Signed and notarized by Apple: it opens the way any Mac app opens. No security warnings, no right-click workarounds.

cards.title: It updates itself
cards.body: New versions arrive inside the app, and every one of them is written up in the release notes.

cards.title: Your files stay yours
cards.body: Your audio and reference images live on your machine. You can plan a whole piece with no connection at all.
